sentences.japanese: これにつきまして、お考えをお聞かせ願えればと存じます。
sentences.english: I look forward to hearing your thoughts on this matter.

sentences.japanese: 感謝のしるしにこれをさし上げたいと存じます。
sentences.english: May I present this to you in token of my appreciation?

sentences.japanese: 皆様にお話出来ることを光栄に存じます。
sentences.english: I esteem it an honor to address this audience.

sentences.japanese: あなたは弊社のことを既にご存じかと思います。
sentences.english: You have, no doubt, heard of our company.
